successors.name: Vindhya Pradesh
successors.text: Panna district, Madhya Pradesh (the page names only Panna district; '6724 km2 with 1,008 villages' in 1901)

ledger.x: 1731: On Chhatrasal's death his kingdom is divided, one-third going to the Peshwa Baji Rao I; Panna passes to Harde Sah.
1 January 1950: the ruler accedes to India; the state becomes Panna District of Vindhya Pradesh.

certainty.note: The page names no boundaries; Panna district is a stand-in matching the 6724 km2 area.
